description: This file defines the 'GenericPlayerContext' structure and related components used for managing media playback state and configuration within a GStreamer-based media player. It includes class definitions, data members for GStreamer elements, flags for playback control, and a rectangle structure for video geometry.

classes.name: Rectangle
classes.description: A structure representing a rectangular area, used for video geometry, with utility methods for checking if it is empty and for clearing its values.

classes.name: GenericPlayerContext
classes.description: A structure encapsulating the state and resources needed for media playback, including GStreamer elements, buffers, flags for data flow control, and playback parameters.

methods.name: Rectangle()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing rectangle to zero dimensions.

methods.name: Rectangle(int, int, int, int)
methods.description: Constructor initializing rectangle with specified x, y, width, and height.

methods.name: empty()
methods.description: Checks if the rectangle has zero width or height.

methods.name: clear()
methods.description: Resets the rectangle's dimensions to zero.
